commits.message:
fix(release): the Publish job's cap sits above the registry wait publish.mjs budgets (brandon-unfiled-3248.frhb)

publish.mjs waits up to 10 minutes for the registry to serve the platform
packages; the job was capped at 5. v1.236.13's wait ran past four minutes and
the job was cancelled with its packages already accepted.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.236.13
